name: @qandeel-company/command-center-ui
description: C5 Tree of Light — the Founder Command Center browser UI: the company as a structured executive surface (Founder, CEO, department columns, goals along the bottom, gold execution lines; DOM + SVG, no WebGL), lenses, Founder Attention, conversation, governed action confirmation and the timeline. Compiled by tsc to native ES modules; no bundler, no dependency, no remote asset.
